pages.text: A tokamak (R = 6.2 m, a = 2 m): a ring of plasma confined by toroidal and poloidal fields, heated until its fuel fuses. The metals are smelted in the burning plasma.

$(thing)Set$(): Toroidal field Bt, Plasma current Ip, Density n, Auxiliary heating.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Impurity influx from the wall: Z_eff rises by up to 30% (d = −1 clean ... +1 dirty), and bremsstrahlung with it.

$(thing)Limits$(): β above the Troyon limit: the plasma disrupts; Above the Greenwald density: radiative collapse, disruption; Safety factor below 2: external kink, disruption; Interlock: toroidal field coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the toroidal field coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Smelting rate follows the power heating the plasma: fusion heating plus your own.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Effective charge: Z_eff$(br)Reactivity ⟨σv⟩: ⟨σv⟩ = C·T^(−2/3)·exp(−3(E_G/4T)^(1/3))$(br)Fusion power: P_fus = ¼n²⟨σv⟩E_f·V$(br)Charged-particle heating: P_α = f_ch·P_fus$(br)Bremsstrahlung: P_br = 5.35×10⁻³·Z_eff·n²·√T·V$(br)Confinement time τ_E: τ_E = 0.0562·I^0.93·B^0.15·n^0.41·P^−0.69·R^1.97·κ^0.78·ε^0.58·M^0.19$(br)Stored energy: W = 3nTV
